title: quintinia media
intro: Quintinia media, commonly known as the Five-Valve or Tukau, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. It has been used in traditional Maori medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's health benefits are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Quintinia media include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
